fusions.name: Pond Procession
fusions.desc: Flaps a slap of pond water at the first enemy in line for 11 damage, knocking it back 2.5 tiles and leaving it [Soaked] for 6 seconds. A row of chicks follows you for 8 seconds, pecking for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Unruffled Peck
fusions.desc: A calm peck that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds, with a 25% chance to leave it [Soaked] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Shaken Dry
fusions.desc: Shakes up to 3 conditions off your feathers, and your movement speed rises by 15% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Water Off the Back
fusions.desc: Each affliction laid on you has a 20% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it.
